items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Minnow was sick, too. That's why they got Coleman... Minnow, the trumpet player... He was drinkin' with them, and so was I drinkin' with them... Minnow went to stand up to play a solo.

ctx.x: Jerry was out, too, and he brought in Pete Clark. You know, Jerry was a sick man anyway. He brought in Pete Clark. Minnow was sick, too. That's why they got Coleman.
